purpose.domain_detail: Video club (video rental store) management system - listings submenu
purpose.summary: This program implements a navigable menu for the 'Listados' (Reports/Listings) section of a video club management application. It allows the user to navigate between options (Socios/Members, Peliculas/Movies, Alquileres/Rentals, and Escape/Return) using arrow keys and Enter, highlighting the selected option and displaying contextual help text. Selecting the Peliculas option calls an external subprogram 'LIST-PEL'.

notable_features: Keyboard navigation using 88-level condition names for ESC, TAB, arrow keys, ENTER
ACCEPT ... FROM ESCAPE KEY for keyboard input
CALL/CANCEL pattern for dynamic subprogram loading
Screen-based interactive menu with highlight and help text
verdict.notes: Source uses tab indentation throughout, consistent with free-format or tab-format COBOL. Spanish-language identifiers and help text (e.g. 'Pel¡culas', 'Men£') with latin-1 encoding artifacts. No ENVIRONMENT DIVISION present. The program appears to be part of a larger video rental shop application.
